message:
Cinematic or Documentary? How to Choose Your Wedding Video Style

• Cinematic films are polished and edited to music, like a short movie.
• Documentary films play events out more fully, and in order.
• Or both: many videographers deliver a tight 3–5 minute highlight film plus a longer edit.

Before you book, watch a couple of complete films, not just highlight reels, and listen: are the vows and toasts crisp, or muddy and wind-blown?
